Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic, was used while designing and building this website.

## What Claude was used for

- The site's design: layout, colours, typography, and the templates behind each page.
- The interactive isogeny graphs on the home page: the script that computes them and the code that draws them.
- Page skeletons and the editing instructions inside the source files.
- Converting my CV from PDF into the HTML version on the [CV](../cv/index.qmd) page.

## What is mine

The mathematics, the research described here, and the information about my papers, talks and teaching are my own. Every change Claude made was proposed as a pull request, which I reviewed before merging.

## Checking

The isogeny graph data is computed by a script that checks its own output against known results (the number of supersingular curves, the modular polynomials, the mass formula, and the Ramanujan bound) and stops if any check fails.

## Record

Changes made with Claude are marked "Co-Authored-By: Claude" in the [history of this site's repository](https://github.com/wmahaney/wmahaney.github.io/commits/main).
